# Aurora Ledger — Style Reference

> Editorial ink on white marble, with one deep teal for every action.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marble | `#FAFAF7` | `--color-marble` | Page background |
| Ink | `#16181D` | `--color-ink` | Body text and headings |
| Deep Teal | `#0F766E` | `--color-teal` | Primary / CTA, links |
| Brass | `#B45309` | `--color-brass` | Secondary accent |
| Hairline | `#E4E4DF` | `--color-hairline` | Borders |
| Alert Red | `#DC2626` | `--color-alert` | Errors |

## Tokens — Typography

### Fraunces
Used for headlines.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Display | Fraunces | 600 | 56px | 1.05 | -0.02em | `--text-display` |
| Heading | Fraunces | 600 | 32px | 1.15 | -0.01em | `--text-h2` |
| Body | "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif | 400 | 16px | 1.6 | 0 | `--text-body` |
| Label | Inter | 600 | 13px | 1.3 | 0.02em | `--text-label` |
| Code | JetBrains Mono | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | 0 | `--text-code` |

## Tokens — Spacing & Shapes

### Border Radius

| Name | Value |
|---|---|
| Card | 12px |
| Button | 999px |
| Input | 8px |

## Components

### Black Pill Button (Primary)
A pill with a teal fill. Hover lifts with a short transition.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Keep one accent colour per screen
- Let headlines carry the page

### Don't
- Add gradients behind text
- Use more than two weights of the display face
